narrative: Operator directive: match the leaderboard leaders (27-31B, greedy-direct). Tests whether gemma-4-31B used the WINNERS' way (direct greedy action generator) discovers levels where our induce-then-plan stack (9B, and 31B-as-inducer in exp5722) scores 0. First real test of the winner architecture for us -- all prior tests used our own architecture.
